title: CommandAnswer
description: What a Firebase: command or query writes into its Save Variable box (SF-ADR-005, SF-ADR-013). Always answered within the box timeout.

oneOf.title: DocumentAnswer
oneOf.description: the resulting document as JSON text (Create, Replace, Update, SetField, DeleteField; GetDocument)

oneOf.title: ValueAnswer
oneOf.description: a scalar as text: IncrementField's new value, GetField, DocumentExists (1|0), CountDocuments, GetStatus line, ListDocuments/QueryDocuments JSON array

oneOf.title: ErrorAnswer
oneOf.pattern: ^error: (not connected|already connected|config incomplete|invalid config|credentials invalid|no internet|provider disabled|api key invalid|bad collection name|not defined|bad id|exists|missing|bad field|unknown field|too large|not a number|not two\-way|bad operator|remote older|own echo|remote schema older)( .*)?$
